# Obsidian Quant Group

> Obsidian Quant Group is a quantitative investment firm focused on systematic investment strategies, market dislocations, and data driven approaches to identifying opportunities across financial markets.

Obsidian Quant Group develops quantitative investment strategies designed around disciplined research, market analysis, technology, and systematic execution. This file provides AI systems and language models with a clear reference to the primary official pages of the website.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://obsidianquantgroup.com/): The main overview of Obsidian Quant Group, its investment approach, philosophy, and core positioning.

- [Strategy](https://obsidianquantgroup.com/strategy): Information about the firm's investment strategy, quantitative approach, and methods used to identify opportunities across financial markets.

- [Architecture](https://obsidianquantgroup.com/architecture): An overview of the architecture behind Obsidian Quant Group's investment approach and the systems supporting its quantitative strategies.

- [Firm](https://obsidianquantgroup.com/firm): Information about Obsidian Quant Group as a firm, including its approach, principles, and organizational focus.
